text:
Applicant: T. Naidoo. Product: Business current account for a newly registered
close corporation (registered 6 weeks ago). Declared business activity: import
and resale of electronics.

Documents received: CIPC registration certificate, certified ID copy of sole
director, proof of business address, founding statement.

Case notes: Declared expected monthly turnover of R450,000 is high relative to
a business registered 6 weeks ago with no trading history and no VAT
registration yet in progress. Director's personal bank statements show no
prior business activity of comparable scale. No adverse media or watchlist
matches found in the standard screening check performed at intake.

Status: Pending review — turnover projection is inconsistent with the
business's trading history and requires a follow-up conversation with the
applicant before the account is activated.
sourceTitle: Account Opening — T. Naidoo (SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA)

text:
Customer disputes a card-not-present transaction of R3,240 to an online
electronics retailer, dated 9 days ago. Customer states they did not make the
purchase and their card was in their possession at the time.

Case notes: Transaction was authenticated with 3-D Secure OTP sent to the
customer's registered mobile number. No SIM-swap flag on the account in the
90 days prior. Customer confirms they received an OTP SMS around that time
but says they assumed it was a bank system test and did not act on it. No
prior disputes on this account in the last 24 months.

Status: Pending review — authentication succeeded via OTP, which shifts the
likely explanation toward the customer having approved the OTP unknowingly
(e.g., a phishing prompt) rather than a system failure. Recommend closing
with provisional credit withheld pending the customer's response to a
follow-up question about how the OTP was used.
sourceTitle: Customer Dispute — Card Transaction Query, ref 88213 (SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA)

text:
Applicant: J. Mokoena. Product: Personal loan, requested amount R85,000, term 36 months.
Employment: Permanent, 4 years at current employer, verified via payslip and
bank statements (3 months attached). Existing accounts: one active credit
card (limit R20,000, R4,200 outstanding), no defaults on record.

Supporting documents received: certified ID copy, 3 months bank statements,
latest payslip, proof of residence dated within 3 months.

Case notes: Bank statements show a single cash deposit of R62,000 on the
15th of the prior month, description field blank, no accompanying source-of-funds
document attached. All other transactions are consistent with declared salary
and normal household spending. Application otherwise complete and consistent
with a standard affordability assessment.

Status: Pending manual review — flagged for the undocumented large cash deposit
before the affordability decision can be finalized.
sourceTitle: Loan Application — J. Mokoena (SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA)
